name: Brand Introduction
description: A confident 30-second hello — your mascot steps into the spotlight, owns the frame, and waves the world in.

clips.prompt: {mascot_description} steps into a clean studio set bathed in soft warm light, looks up at the camera, and gives a friendly wave. Smooth cinematic motion, gentle dolly-in, shallow depth of field, subtle ambient light.
Same mascot turns slightly, smiles confidently at the camera, and crosses arms in a relaxed hero pose. The background gently brightens. Smooth subtle motion, no cuts.
Camera slowly orbits around the mascot as soft brand-colored light bands swirl behind, framing the character. Calm, premium, polished motion.
The mascot does a playful little spin or quick dance step, then lands back into a confident pose. Energetic but graceful, smooth motion blur.
The mascot points toward the camera with an inviting expression, as soft light flares hint at brand colors behind. Cinematic, welcoming.
The mascot gives one final friendly wave, smiles, and the camera slowly pulls back as soft warm light envelops the frame. Polished outro, gentle fade-out feel.
